# GluLess

> An agent-native executable contract language and runtime built around Goal, Limits, and Utilities.

GluLess lets humans and agents declare a Goal, Limits, and Utilities. The runtime resolves, filters, authorizes, executes, and verifies — without glue code.

## Core

- [README](README.md): purpose, model, pipeline, and current status
- [OWNERSHIP](OWNERSHIP.md): what GluLess owns, upstream authorities, extension boundary
- [AGENTS](AGENTS.md): agent operating contract, decision rules, repo layout

## Specification

- [gluless-specification](docs/gluless-specification.md): language primitives, type system, computational model, invariants
- [VISION](docs/VISION.md): design principles, API-first rules, testing mandate

## Architecture

- [connections-and-plugins](docs/connections-and-plugins.md): importers, registry modes, transport bindings, all API endpoints, how to add a new provider

- [AGENT](`.agents/agents/glu-agent/AGENT.md`): wire spec for the reference GLU agent — endpoints, AG-UI events, state shape, contract format
